Pastor James R. Shaw holds M.Div. from Concordia Theological Seminary (Fort Wayne, LCMS seminary). Currently meets at Saint Luke's Anglican Church (temporary) — verify whether this reflects church-plant phase or facility-share arrangement.

churches.assessment: Agnus Dei is a gem for anyone seeking traditional, confessional Lutheran worship. Pastor James Shaw (M.Div., Concordia Fort Wayne) explicitly describes the church as rejecting modern religious fads in favor of 'liturgical, reverent, consistent, orthodox, and Bible-based practice.' This is exactly the kind of church that values theological precision and historic Christianity. The only caution is independent status (not formally LCMS/NALC), but the confession is solid.
churches.denomination_detail: Independent confessional Lutheran (not LCMS; pastor is a former LCMS clergyman)
churches.enrichment_notes: Distinct from ELCA 'Agnus Dei Lutheran Church' in Gig Harbor, WA — different congregation and URL. The Fredericksburg VA entry (adlutheran.org) is independent confessional.

churches.assessment: North Heights Lutheran Church Arden Hills — LCMC denomination (Lutheran Congregations in Mission for Christ). Two locations (Arden Hills and Roseville). Self-describes as 'Spirit-filled, Bible-believing, Christ-centered.' LCMC is a more conservative/orthodox Lutheran body than ELCA. Communion on first Sunday monthly. Traditional worship available. The 'Spirit-filled' language suggests charismatic Lutheran tradition. LCMC affiliation is generally a positive indicator vs. ELCA. ~70 minute services.

churches.assessment: The Way Church is a WELS (Wisconsin Evangelical Lutheran Synod) church plant in Fredericksburg, meeting at Highmark Brewery on Sundays at 10 AM. Led by Pastor Matt Rothe, planted in 2017 by 16 families from Trinity Lutheran in Woodbridge. WELS is one of the most conservative Lutheran bodies in America — male-only ordination, closed communion, confessional Lutheranism. The brewery venue is creative and culturally engaged without compromising doctrine. Active Facebook and Instagram presence.
churches.gender_detail: WELS ordains only men — conservative confessional Lutheran

Prior record asserts planted from 'Trinity Lutheran Woodbridge' (which would be WELS if Trinity-Woodbridge is WELS). Meets at Highmark Brewery — unusual venue. Keep yellow; verify WELS affiliation via WELS congregation locator (wels.net/find-a-church).
